description: This file implements a validation service for flow validation within a flow-based application, including functions to check node connectivity, parameter requirements, nested configurations, and edge consistency.

classes.name: IValidationResult
classes.description: Interface representing validation issues for a node, including id, label, name, and issues array.

methods.name: checkFlowValidation
methods.description: Asynchronous function that validates a flow by its ID and optional workspace ID, checking node connectivity, parameters, nested configs, and edges, returning validation issues.
